prompt: Some people think that watching sports as leisure activity is a wastage of time. Do you agree or disagree? give reasons and examples
essay:
It is believed that people waste time while watching sports during their free time. Although some people believe that watching sports is unproductive and prevents them from engaging in more meaningful activities, I disagree that watching sports events can waste time, as they offer encouragement, education and  strengthen relationships.

One major reason why watching sports matches is beneficial is that they provide the opportunity to learn about teamwork. Since many students and workers are often required to work in a team for their academic and professional projects, watching athletes playing together can significantly teach them the importance of teamwork when they win the matches. Therefore, watching sports is not only helpful for spending leisure time but also encourages individuals to learn something important from them.

Education is another advantage that is gained from sports because many countries come together to play on the one national platform. People learn about different countries' names, players, scoring  factors and rules of games, which ultimately improves their general knowledge. According to people, if they watch sports after work only for relaxation, they are also learning about vital aspects of games , which can increase their awareness. These benefits prove that watching sports is actually a way to spend free time meaningfully.

Watching sports with family members and friends can foster strong relationships. This is because people have hectic schedules and they have to engage in professional activities for most of the days. As  a result, they have less time to spend with loved ones. However, live sports bring people together and allow them to communicate, eat and sit together for some time. This creates a very positive environment and strengthens their relationships.

In conclusion, watching sports can significantly enhance people's relationships, social interactions and understanding of teamwork. These aspects are particularly important in today's busy lifestyle, as it allows people to relax and spend quality time with loved ones. Therefore, I strongly believe that watching sports is a productive activity.
